Ayyuhal mazloom

Minhal ne ek din aake kaha
Ay maula mere ay zainul aba
Gham ziada kahan guzre tumpar
Dil thaam liya khun rone lage
Khun rote huwe bas itna kaha
Ash sham

1) Minhal tarap kar kehne laga
Rone ka sabab maula he kya
Miraas shahadat aap ki he
Maula ne kaha la raib magar
Uff tune nahin insaaf kiya
Beshak miras shahadat he
Ye ale nabi ki fitrat he
Sar beparda maa behno ka
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
2) Minhal mein kaise zinda hun
Pal pal jeeta hun marta hun
In ankhon ne jo kuchh dekha
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
3) Aghaaz he shame gharibaan se
Khun tapka chashme giryaan se
Behnon ka khula sar saamne tha
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
4) Kaise bhulun us manzar ko
Neze pe phupi ki chadar ko
Sahil se jo ghazi ne dekha
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
5) Namoose payambar be chaadar
Aur sar pe baraste woh patthar
Tar khoon mein tha sab ka chehra
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
6) Na gham tauqo zanjeer ka tha
Gham phupiyon ka hamsheer ka tha
Bazaar ke gham ne maar diya
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
7) Allah mere ye hadde sitam
Pehro the khare darbaar mein ham
Aur takht pe qatil betha tha
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad
8) Ek sham ka ik zindaan ka gham
Masoom si nanni jaan ka gham
Jo ho na saki marke bhi riha
Ek ye bhi meri miraas thi kya
Ash sham
Sajjad haey Sajjad

Aur sham ki who galiyaan dekho
Bimaar jahan kehta hi raha

from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/sajjad-haye-sajjad.md')
header, original = path.read_text().split('\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = original.strip().replace('�Rehano sarwar�', '“Rehano sarwar”')
roman = re.sub(r'(?m)"'^([1-9])'"\\) ', lambda match: '\\n' + str(int(match[1]) + 2) + '\\n', roman)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[0].upper() + line[1:] if line else line for line in roman.splitlines())
for old, new in {
    'ay zainul aba': 'ay Zainul Aba',
    'Ash sham': 'Ash Sham',
    'shame gharibaan': 'Sham-e Gharibaan',
    'jo ghazi': 'jo Ghazi',
    'Ek sham ka': 'Ek Sham ka',
    '“Rehano sarwar” sham': '“Rehano Sarwar” Sham',
    'Aur sham ki': 'Aur Sham ki',
}.items():
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
